method: Re-ran CON-001 convergence null model with 20581 canonical isoforms (1 per gene from canonical_gene_uniprot) vs 93465 total isoforms. Same null model: 1000 permutations shuffling vocabulary labels.
conclusion: Canonical-only analysis (1 isoform per gene, 20581 proteins) yields z=84.2 vs all-isoform z=86.4 (ratio=0.97). Enrichment: 2.08x vs 1.88x. Both are highly significant (p<0.001). Isoform inflation does not explain the convergence signal.
